title: hieracium hispanicum subsp. dimorphotrichum
intro: Hieracium hispanicum subsp. dimorphotrichum, commonly known as Spanish hawk's beard or diminutive hawkweed, is a plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae) native to the Iberian Peninsula. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to alleviate digestive issues and reduce oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium hispanicum subsp. dimorphotrichum include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial properties, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
